summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a notice to the market that it has been included in the ISE portfolio for the 18th consecutive year. This is a routine ESG-related disclosure with no transaction, corporate action, or special situation. No deal terms, prices, recommendations, or structural mechanics are present. The filing is simply a reaffirmation of the company's sustainability index membership. There is no US-equivalent special situation; it is a standard foreign private issuer report of an index inclusion.
